reviews.title: Quiet Fans!!
reviews.comment: These fans are the best. The noise level is so low with the magnetic bearings. The color is bright. Only the one color though. But this brand has several color options.
reviews.author: Royce Caswell

reviews.title: Decent case fan.
reviews.comment: Works perfectly very satisfied overall quiet, easy to install, and decent quality for what I paid.
reviews.author: Ktmax33

reviews.title: Good quality, but can be noisey.
reviews.comment: The fan quality is great, you wouldn't go wrong purchasing this. I just should have gotten the larger fan. And yes when they are under power, it sounds like a swarm of hornets. But I myself like the sound. I know when I am doing something that is power hungry.
reviews.author: Braden Blosser
